sections.title: nexo.stream
entries: kafka(name: str, partitions: int?, servers: str?, key: str|secret?) -> stream

A stream of the local broker (.nexo/streams), or a topic of the Kafka brokers of servers: ("user@host:9092,host2:9092", key: their password); `when kafka(...) as msg:` handles each message, `kafka(...).send(value, key?, at?)` adds one.
rabbit(name: str, url: str?, key: str|secret?) -> stream
A stream of the local broker, as kafka, or a queue of the RabbitMQ of url: ("amqp://user@host/", key: its password).
A stream of the local broker, as kafka, or an event hub of an Azure namespace (through its Kafka endpoint, with a token of Azure AD).
The messages a WebSocket server sends (wss://, or ws:// on this machine); `send(text)` writes one on the same connection.
An Amazon SQS queue with region:, otherwise a stream of the local broker.
An Amazon Kinesis stream (its shards are partitions) with region:, otherwise local.
An Azure Service Bus queue with namespace:, otherwise local.
A Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic with project:, read through a subscription of the program; otherwise local.
